title: legubiao/quadruped_ros2_control
abstract:
ROS2-Control implementations for Quadruped robots, include sim2real

# Quadruped ROS2 Control This repository contains the ros2-control based controllers for the quadruped robot. * [Controllers](controllers): contains the ros2-control controllers * [Commands](commands): contains command node used to send command to the controller * [Descriptions](descriptions): contains the urdf model of the robot * [Hardwares](hardwares): contains the ros2-control hardware interface for the robot > **Warning:** Default branch was developed under ROS2 Jazzy. For ROS2 Humble, please check out **humble** branch. Quick Start * rosdep * Compile the package ### 1.1 Mujoco Simulator or Real Unitree Robot > **Warning:** CycloneDDS ROS2 RMW may conflict with unitree_sdk2. If you cannot launch unitree mujoco simulation > without `sudo`, then you cannot used `unitree_mujoco_hardware`. This conflict could be solved by one of below two > methods: > 1. Uninstall CycloneDDS ROS2 RMW, used another ROS2 RMW, such as FastDDS **[Recommended]**. > 2. Follow the guide in [unitree_ros2](https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unitree_ros2) to configure the ROS2 RMW by compiling cyclone dds. * Compile Unitree Hardware Interfaces * Follow the guide in [unitree_mujoco](https://github.com/legubiao/unitree_mujoco) to launch the unitree mujoco go2 simulation * Launch the ros2-control * Run the keyboard control node ### 1.3 Gazebo Harmonic Simulator * Install Gazebo * Compile Gazebo Playground * Launch the ros2-control * Run the keyboard control node For more details, please refer to the [unitree guide controller](controllers/unitree_guide_controller/) and [go2 description](descriptions/unitree/go2_description/). ## What's

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：基于 ros2_control 构建四足机器人控制器、命令节点、URDF 描述与硬件接口，提供 MuJoCo/Gazebo/Isaac Sim 仿真和真实 Unitree Go2 的统一控制栈。


# 一、动机

> 四足机器人从仿真到真机部署常缺乏统一、可复用的 ROS2 控制与硬件接口方案，现有实现分散且仿真/真机切换成本高。


# 二、方法

> 基于 ros2_control 构建四足机器人控制器、命令节点、URDF 描述与硬件接口，提供 MuJoCo/Gazebo/Isaac Sim 仿真和真实 Unitree Go2 的统一控制栈。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 已完成真实 Unitree Go2 支持（2025-03-30）、Isaac Sim 支持（2025-05-20）和 Gazebo Playground/OCS2 控制器；重构了 FSM 与 Unitree Guide Controller；支持 ROS2 Jazzy，并提供 Humble 分支。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该仓库是工程集成型工作，缺少定量性能对比；但 DDS/RMW 与 unitree_sdk2 冲突等细节说明 sim2real 部署中通信与接口适配至关重要，可直接复用于四足控制实验平台搭建。
